verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਕਵਾਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਲਹਿਰ ਤਰੰਗ ਉਠੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: lakh dhareeaau kavaau vich lakh lakh lahir tara(n)g uTha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: In the one word of the Lord lacs of rivers (of life) flow and lacs of waves come up in them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸ ਲਹਰ ਤਰੰਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਵਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: eikas lahar tara(n)g vich lakh lakh dhareeaau vaha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: In His one wave again, lacs of rivers (of life) flow.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸ ਇਕਸ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਖ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਅਕਾਰ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: eikas ikas dhareeaau vich lakh avataar akaar fira(n)dhe|

en.bdb: In each river, in the form of incarnations, lacs of jivs assuming many forms are roaming about.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਛ ਕਛ ਮਰਿਜੀਵੜੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ਨ ਥਾਹ ਲਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: machh kachh marijeevaRe agam athaeh na thaeh laha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Incarnations in the form of fish and tortoise dive into it but they cannot fathom its depth, i.e. they cannot know the limits of that supreme reality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ਨ ਲਹਿਰ ਤਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: paravadhagaar apaar hai paaraavaar na lahir tara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: That sustainer Lord is beyond all limits; none can know the bounds of his waves.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਜਰਾਵਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖ ਅਜਰ ਜਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: ajaraavar satigur purakh gurmat gurusikh ajar jara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: That true Guru is the excellent purus and the disciples of the Guru bear the unbearable, through the wisdom of the Guru (gurmat).
Rare are the people who undertake such devotional worship.
